issues.fix: Retain matched controls and expand to underclaims, wrong-node claims, later missing edges and non-self-loop failures before reporting robust critic generalization.

issues.evidence: Exact bounded dynamics and explicit objectives support local simulation and plan criticism; broader relational or value-model generalization needs separate held-out mechanism evidence.
issues.fix: Report bounded task scope and mechanism-specific validation; do not infer generic planning or successor-feature guarantees.

review_method: Fresh per-record visible-prompt recomputation and exact hash/schema/contract/target checks with expert-owned semantics and exhaustive equal-route path counter; actual-agent factual-tag examples inspected; exact prompt/task/gold equality checked against prior independently reviewed candidates. No producer/reference/oracle or other verdict files read.
